hunks.baseline: Unlike the dejected Hyuk Mujin, Han Yeop’s voice was calm.
hunks.sol: Unlike the dejected Hyuk Mujin, Han Yeop sounded calm.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin shut his mouth. Han Yeop had it right. Jopil’s Flame Divine Palm had broken bones and torn heart meridians, but the wound he’d taken was somewhere else.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin fell silent. Han Yeop had it exactly right. Jopil’s Flame Divine Palm had broken bones and torn heart meridians, but the real wound lay elsewhere.

hunks.baseline: “Overwhelming” wasn’t enough. All his effort, all his pride in his own martial arts, had been ripped up by the roots.
hunks.sol: Even *overwhelming* wasn’t enough to describe it. All his effort, all his pride in his martial arts, had been ripped up by the roots.

hunks.baseline: “I admitted that I’m weak. It wasn’t even that hard. I’ve always known. But…”
hunks.sol: “I admitted that I’m weak. It wasn’t even hard. I’ve always known. But…”

hunks.baseline: Han Yeop went on, his voice firm.
hunks.sol: Han Yeop continued, his voice firm.

hunks.baseline: “Thinking about that made me happy. If I become a Peak master, I can get that strong too. Something like that.”
hunks.sol: “Once I started thinking that way, I felt happy. If I become a Peak master, I can get that strong too. That sort of thing.”

hunks.baseline: *You’ve changed. You too.*
hunks.sol: *You’ve changed too.*

hunks.baseline: Even the timid second-rate martial artist had, before anyone noticed, stepped into that current. Hyuk Mujin felt his heart lurch. The next words burst out before he could stop them.
hunks.sol: Even Hyuk Mujin, once a timid second-rate martial artist, had joined that current before he knew it. His heart suddenly surged, and the words burst out before he could stop them.

hunks.baseline: Han Yeop’s eyes went round, then he flashed a grin.
hunks.sol: Han Yeop’s eyes widened, then he flashed a grin.
They both thought of the same person.
Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: They thought of the same person at the same time. Jin Taekyung. He was already running far ahead of them. What was he doing now?
hunks.sol: He was already racing far ahead of them. What was he doing now?

hunks.baseline: You could call it the nostalgia filter of a sergeant in his last stretch before discharge.

hunks.sol: *Well, there’s no need to announce anything. Seeing their faces is enough.*

hunks.baseline: The moment I entered the room, the reactions came at once. Gong Yacheong, still pale, tried to rise, and I stopped him. Then I pulled Socheon, who had dropped into a full bow, back to his feet.
hunks.sol: The reactions came the moment I entered the room. Gong Yacheong, still pale, tried to rise, and I stopped him. Then I pulled Socheon, who had dropped into a full bow, back to his feet.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve received a kindness a hundred bows couldn’t repay.”
hunks.sol: “A hundred bows wouldn’t be enough to repay what you’ve done for us.”

hunks.baseline: “Big brother, did you put on the Benefactor’s kindness? Show me too. Is it pretty?”
hunks.sol: “Big Brother, are you wearing the Benefactor’s kindness? Show me too. Is it pretty?”

hunks.baseline: *Uh. That’s clothes, isn’t it?*
hunks.sol: *Uh. That’s not clothing.*

hunks.baseline: “I didn’t do it to hear you flatter me. I even left you behind once.”
hunks.sol: “I didn’t do it for praise. I even left you behind once.”

hunks.baseline: I remembered that night Jopil had been chasing us. Gong Yacheong had been badly poisoned and had wanted to stay behind. Just as he had, I’d had to make a choice.
hunks.sol: I remembered the night Jopil had chased us. Gong Yacheong had been badly poisoned and had wanted to be left behind. Just as he had, I’d had to make a choice.

hunks.baseline: After a great deal of inner conflict, the decision I reached was to go back for him.
hunks.sol: After agonizing over it, I had decided to go back for him.

hunks.baseline: If Gong Yacheong, who never left his hospital room, knew about it, then anyone in the Jin Family of Taiyuan with eyes and ears already knew.
hunks.sol: If Gong Yacheong, who never left his hospital room, knew about it, then anyone in the Jin Family of Taiyuan with eyes and ears must already know.

hunks.sol: If there was even one spy among us, we might as well set up a loudspeaker aimed at North Korea.

hunks.baseline: *Is this war really going to be all right like this?*
hunks.sol: *Is this war really going to be all right?*

hunks.baseline: I waved the thought away. What did it matter to me? Soon enough, it wouldn’t have anything to do with me anyway.
hunks.sol: I shook off the thought. What did it matter to me? Soon enough, none of this would have anything to do with me anyway.

hunks.baseline: They said a rumor traveled a thousand li without feet. After I’d taken Jopil down, my name seemed to have started spreading in earnest.
hunks.sol: They said rumors had no feet, yet traveled a thousand li. After I’d taken down Jopil, my name seemed to have started spreading in earnest.

hunks.sol: I opened the Quest Window for a quick look. I had about fifty Fame left to go.

hunks.baseline: Logout was as good as decided.
hunks.sol: Logout was practically a done deal.

hunks.sol: Of course, they had no way of knowing my situation. I listened quietly to Gong Yacheong and Socheon for a while, then rose from my seat.

hunks.baseline: Gong Yacheong was the one who stopped Socheon when the boy looked disappointed.
hunks.sol: Socheon looked disappointed, but Gong Yacheong stopped him.

hunks.baseline: “Young Master Jin. You may be leaving, but shouldn’t you take the thing you left behind?”
hunks.sol: “Young Master Jin. Even if you must leave, shouldn’t you take what you left behind?”

hunks.baseline: “The thing I left behind?”
hunks.sol: “What I left behind?”

hunks.baseline: I thought about it for a moment, but there was no way I’d left anything. Thanks to the cheat known as Inventory, my hands were always empty.
hunks.sol: I thought about it for a moment, but there was no way I’d left anything. Thanks to the cheat known as Inventory, I always traveled light.

hunks.baseline: “You were in no state to collect it. Now that its owner has come, returning it is only right.”
hunks.sol: “You were in no state to collect it at the time. Now that its owner is here, returning it is only right.”

hunks.sol: Still bewildered, I accepted the bundle. It was fairly heavy. Just as I was about to check what was inside, Gong Yacheong spoke.

hunks.sol: *Shit. It always gives me the good stuff after everything’s over.*
